vulns.description: aiohttp is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. In aiohttp before version 3.7.4 there is an open redirect vulnerability.
aiohttp is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. aiohttp v3.8.4 and earlier are bundled with llhttp v6.0.6. Vulnerable to HTTP request smuggling.
aiohttp is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Improper validation of HTTP method makes aiohttp vulnerable to CRLF injection.

aiohttp is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. When using aiohttp as a web server and configuring static routes, it is necessary to specify the root path for static files. Additionally, the option follow_symlinks can be used to determine whether to follow symbolic links outside the static root directory.
In Pallets Jinja before 2.10.1, str.format_map is allowed, leading to sandbox escape.
This affects the package jinja2. ReDoS via the urlize filter.

A vulnerability was discovered in the PyYAML library, where it is susceptible to arbitrary code execution when it processes untrusted YAML files through the full_load method or with the FullLoader loader.
